_doc: Clips for the MPFB2 background folk (2026-11-21, STOCKPILE_RESERVE_PROMPT): the six Stockpile workers and the auction hall's five extra people share ONE skeleton (MPFB 'mixamo' rig), so this set is retargeted once onto sp_shovel_a.glb (blender -b --factory-startup -P tools/ep2_motion/retarget_bvh.py -- --spec tools/ep2_motion/clips_stockpile.json --bvh-dir ~/tools/mocap/cmu --glb <sp_shovel_a.glb> --export-glb <clips.glb> --fps 24), stripped to the skeleton (tools/ep2_blender/strip_clip_donor.py) and shipped as src/episode2/extras/folk_mpfb/folk_clips.glb; the game copies its clips onto every figure. CMU sources (commercial use allowed, tools/ep2_motion/fetch_cmu.sh): 77_02 standing, 81_03 walk, 80_05 digging a hole, 26_09 bend + pick up, 15_06 lean forward + reach for, 18_08 conversation gestures, 13_27 wave/point. Pushing the wheelbarrow is Walk with both hands laid on its grips by Ep2ArmIK; clapping is Ep2ArmIK too (no CMU clip claps).
